Dan Marino's Power Play Football.name: Dan Marino's Powerplay Football
Dan Marino's Power Play Football.summary:
Dan Marino Powerplay Football is an unreleased Sega Mega Drive American football game endorsed by Dan Marino. It was being developed by Park Place Productions to be published by Virgin Interactive Entertainment, but the project was cancelled, likely due to Park Place shedding most of its staff in December 1993. It appeared at Summer CES 1993 in some form.

A prototype build of the game was released by the Video Game History Foundation on December 15, 2025, as part of their Sega Channel archive release.

Puggsy.name: Puggsy
Puggsy.summary: Puggsy is no ordinary game. Using the unique system of Total Object Interaction (TOI), you have to guide Puggsy through some of the best puzzles and most frantic arcade action ever seen in his quest to retrieve his stolen spaceship. Incorporating graphic techniques never seen before, fantastic gameplay plus a complete Junior section for the younger player. Puggsy is destined to become the next world-wide smash hit.
